Vendored Postman JSON Schema

Source: https://schema.getpostman.com/json/collection/v2.1.0/collection.json
Pulled: 2026-05-02

This file is treated as a frozen artifact - do not hand-edit. Refresh by
re-downloading the upstream schema and updating the date above when Postman
publishes a revised v2.1.0 schema.

Used by `schematic/gen/tests/postman_schema.rs` to validate every emitted
Postman collection (and golden fixtures) against Postman's published
contract. The schema declares JSON Schema draft-04 (`$schema`).
